company.name: Authologic
company.shortDescription: Authologic is a system that helps businesses in checking the identity of their clients online.
company.description:
Authologic is a system that helps businesses in checking the identity of their clients online.

Authologic is a provider of identity verification solutions that includes tools for determining identity through online video, data, and digital IDs.

Krzysztof Klimczak, Jarek Sygitowicz, and Marek Rogoziński founded Authologic in 2020 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

productsAndServices.description: An identity infrastructure platform that connects businesses to digital wallets, national eIDs, biometrics, document verification, bank-based verification, and other identity methods through one integration.
productsAndServices.name: OmniID

productsAndServices.description: A verification service that automates customer and business identity checks using eIDs, digital wallets, biometrics, documents, bank-based verification, and connected identity providers.
productsAndServices.name: Automated KYC, KYB & AML Verification

productsAndServices.description: A customer platform for configuring identity-verification journeys, applying brand customization, and monitoring verification activity and conversion performance in real time.
productsAndServices.name: OmniPanel

productsAndServices.description: Embedded software components for adding Authologic’s identity-verification widget to websites and applications.
productsAndServices.name: SDK & WebSDK

productsAndServices.description: An API integration option for connecting business applications to Authologic’s identity-verification methods and receiving verified identity attributes.
productsAndServices.name: OmniLink API

productsAndServices.description: A secure electronic service that lets individuals confirm selected personal data through verification tools and transmit the confirmed information to a participating business.
productsAndServices.name: Single Secure Confirmation of Data
